commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak 37 and headline indices clocking four consecutive distribution sessions, William O'Neil's market-direction rules mandate rigorous defensive discipline. In an unconfirmed market under heavy FII distribution and macro headwinds, swing follow-through frequently aborts. Stan Weinstein's stage analysis cautions against aggressive capital commitments when the tape lacks broad participation, while Mark Minervini's progressive exposure model demands tight stops and reduced sizing. Even as selective equipment and auto-component names exhibit Stage 2 breakout characteristics, new leadership cannot fully decouple from an ailing general market. Capital preservation remains the priority until a verified follow-through day confirms institutional accumulation.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: SEPA / CANSLIM / Stage Analysis / Darvas Box Discipline

AAREYDRUGS.technical: The stock trades above its EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, hovering within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot on 1.63× average volume. RSI at 57 reflects positive momentum, yet the base lacks the distinct volume dry-up and clean volatility contraction typical of top-tier institutional pivots.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Core fundamentals fail CANSLIM benchmarks: Q1 top-line dropped 56.3% YoY with net profit declining 25.6%. Five-year sales growth languishes at 6.3%, ROE is low at ~3.1%, and elevated P/E multiples (~75x) lack earnings backing.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A breakdown below the 97.24 stop breaches base structure; cut losses immediately to avoid holding an illiquid, fundamentally deteriorating asset.

ACE.technical: Classic Stage 2 uptrend with moving averages aligned constructively above the 200-day line. Price carved a clean double bottom / rounded cup (12.8% deep) with a tight 5.6% handle in the upper half. MACD remains above signal and zero line.
ACE.fundamental: Dominant mobile and tower crane market share (>60%) provides durable operating leverage. Operating margins expanded to 20.5% in Q1 FY27 with low leverage, healthy ROCE, and fresh growth catalysts from defense orders and the KATO Works joint venture.
ACE.risk: A close below 1190.67 violates handle support; trigger an immediate stop-loss to protect capital against broader cyclical equipment drag.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Maintains a mature Stage 2 trajectory above rising 50-day and 200-day moving averages. Currently trades within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot on 1.49× volume, though overhead supply and large-cap institutional selling cap immediate velocity.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Moat in port operations drove 18.6% Q1 revenue expansion led by international terminal throughput. However, net profit growth decelerated to 9.2% YoY, and heavy balance-sheet debt coupled with low ROE (~3.7%) constrains CANSLIM leadership status.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Violation of 1774.89 breaks short-term base support; exit per Minervini discipline as large-cap distribution exerts heavy downward pressure.

AEGISLOG.technical: Strong Stage 2 leader pulling back constructively to test its rising 21-day EMA near recent highs. A three-candle bullish reversal confirmed support above the prior candle's midpoint, exhibiting classic VCP supply contraction on the retreat.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Textbook CANSLIM acceleration: Q1 net profit surged 268.9% YoY on 37.1% revenue growth. Liquids and gas terminal expansions via the Vopak joint venture bolster cash generation, operating margins, and structural ROCE (~13.3%).
AEGISLOG.risk: A break below 1383.09 invalidates the 21-EMA pullback pivot; execute stop-loss without hesitation to prevent deeper downside drawdowns.

ALBERTDAVD.technical: Forming an emerging base above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. A double bottom pattern shows neckline pressure with a 1.54× volume uptick and RSI at 57, though overhead resistance from prior distribution ranges remains unresolved.
ALBERTDAVD.fundamental: Balance sheet carries negligible debt (D/E 0.07). While Q1 FY27 revenue rose 39.6% and net profit rebounded to ₹32 Cr, non-operating other income of ₹28 Cr heavily inflated stated profitability, clouding core operating quality.
ALBERTDAVD.risk: A decline beneath 878.59 violates the double bottom swing low; enforce strict stop discipline to avoid extended capital lockup in an erratic small-cap.

ALICON.technical: Exceptional Stage 2 continuation breakout clearing 20-session highs on an enormous 26.65× average volume surge. Price is strongly aligned above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with MACD accelerating above the zero line, confirming decisive institutional accumulation.
ALICON.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM fundamentals: Q1 revenue jumped 37.9% YoY while earnings expanded 67.1%, building on 28.4% growth in Q4. Rising auto component demand and structural shift toward lightweight EV castings expand operating margins and ROCE.
ALICON.risk: A reversal below 704.98 invalidates the high-volume breakout pivot; cut losses immediately in accordance with Minervini progressive exposure rules.
